controls.label: Ellipse width
controls.serializedMeaning: Full local major-axis span before plane rotation and canvas recomposition.
controls.causalObservation: Projected x span and shoulder travel distance change at identical story time while minor axis, source order, story phase, and source pixels remain fixed.

controls.label: Ellipse height
controls.serializedMeaning: Full local minor-axis span before plane rotation and canvas recomposition.
controls.causalObservation: Projected vertical arc and the pitch contribution to depth change while major-axis identity, source order, and story phase remain fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Independent minor-axis geometry, not a generic orbit radius.

controls.label: Plane yaw
controls.serializedMeaning: Rotation of the whole ellipse plane around its vertical axis.
controls.causalObservation: Front gate, shoulder asymmetry, projected width, depth, and z-order change coherently through one rotation matrix; cards remain camera-facing.
controls.ownershipReason: Defines cinematic near-side orientation of the plane.

controls.label: Plane pitch
controls.serializedMeaning: Rotation of the whole ellipse plane around its horizontal axis after yaw.
controls.causalObservation: Vertical projection, depth contribution from the minor axis, front-gate angle, and occlusion change coherently without per-card rotation.
controls.ownershipReason: Defines the authored spatial tilt and shoulder composition.

controls.label: Card size
controls.serializedMeaning: Base card width before source ratio, geometric perspective, density reduction, and deterministic canvas safety cap.
controls.causalObservation: Card bounds and safety-cap activation change while centre path, depth, source ratio, and phase remain fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Sets readable density for the panoramic pass.
